result.quote: But Paul went down, threw himself on the young man, and embraced him. “Do not be alarmed!” he said. “He is still alive!”
result.reason: Verse 20:9 states that the young man fell from the third story and was picked up dead; verse 20:10 states that Paul embraced him and then declared him alive. The key accurately and uniquely summarizes this sequence. The edited question clearly identifies the incident and preserves the original intended fact and answer scope.
